name: example-davinci
title: Example Davinci
author: uia
description: Example app: an agent coordinator as an inbox — decisions grouped by urgency (the urgent one glows), threads per project, projects by stage that scale to dozens of tasks, a log of what was decided for you, rules with switches; each view a route. Plus the one-chat version it replaced.

import type { ModelFamily } from "@/components/ds/model-icons"
import type { StageStatus } from "@/components/ds/stage-track"
import type { Option, Project } from "@/examples/davinci/data"

// davinci v2: the same factory, organised around what the owner actually
// needs: a queue of decisions (state, not messages), conversations per
// project, a place to look at state, a record of what was decided for him,
// and rules that turn repeated decisions into policy.

export type Urgency = "now" | "today" | "later"

export type QueueItem = {
  id: string
  project: Project
  /** The decision category, the unit a rule applies to. */
  category: string
  kind: "choice" | "incident" | "diff" | "preview"
  title: string
  context: string
  options?: Option[]
  pick?: string
  /** What happens with davinci's pick, in one line. */
  consequence: string
  reversible: boolean
  urgency: Urgency
  /** How often the owner went with davinci's pick in this category. */
  agreement?: { accepted: number; total: number }
}

export const STAGES = ["Plan", "Build", "Gates", "Review", "Next", "Main"] as const

/* --------------------------- busy factory ---------------------------- */

// The same factory under load: dozens of tasks in flight at once. A
// simulation behind the side-nav switch (or `?busy`), to see the screens
// hold up. The inbox doesn't grow with it: davinci's job is to keep what
// reaches you to a handful, however much is running.

type Extra = [key: string, title: string, family: ModelFamily, at: number, status: StageStatus, now: string]

function extra([key, title, family, at, status, now]: Extra): ProjectState["tasks"][number] {
  return {
    key,
    title,
    family,
    now,
    stages: STAGES.map((_, i) => (i < at ? "done" : i === at ? status : "todo")),
  }
}

import type { ModelFamily } from "@/components/ds/model-icons"

// The davinci example's world: the Bottega factory seen from one chat.
// Projects, the owner's pending decisions, a live task, an incident, a
// high-risk diff and the quota. All fiction, shaped after the Bottega API.

export const PROJECTS = { bottega: "bottega", blog: "blog" } as const
export type Project = keyof typeof PROJECTS

/** The factory flow a task card shows, in the project's own words. */
export const FLOW = ["Plan", "Build", "Gates", "Review", "Next", "Main"] as const

export type Option = { id: string; label: string; hint: string }

export type Decision = {
  id: string
  project: Project
  kind: "decision"
  question: string
  context: string[]
  options: Option[]
  /** davinci's pick. */
  pick: string
}

    options: [
      { id: "ntfy", label: "ntfy on the tailnet", hint: "nothing leaves the devbox" },
      { id: "telegram", label: "Telegram bot", hint: "messages go through Telegram" },
      { id: "email", label: "Email", hint: "slower, easy to miss" },
    ],
    pick: "ntfy",

  {

    kind: "decision",
    question: "Raise T-289 (batched integration) to high?",

export type Task = {

  family: ModelFamily

  state: "working" | "waiting" | "done"
